Maya: Quick Q — where's the short dashboard I can use for a quick SM% / GPU mem / KV cache summary for today's load? Need to decide an alert tweak before EOD.

Kevin: Use Grafana -> runtime/gpu/overview dashboard. Panels to check: SM Util (panel 3), GPU mem (panel 5), KVCache hitrate (panel 9). Link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abcd123/runtime-gpu-overview

Maya: thanks — can't open that link from my laptop (VPN flaky). Any Datadog alternative queries I can paste into the console?

Kevin: Datadog quick snippets you can run in the Metrics explorer: 
`avg(last_5m):avg:gpu.sm_utilization{env:prod} by {pool}`
`max(last_5m):avg:gpu.mem_usage{env:prod} by {pool}`
KVCache hitrate (15m avg): `avg(last_15m):avg:kvcache.hitrate{env:prod}`

Anita: for alert tuning context — we bumped the SM alert to 90% last month which caused noisy pages on short bursts (~1–2m). Proposal: set SM alert to 88% sustained for 5m, but add an exception when KVCache hitrate > 80% (high cache reduces impact).

Oliver: +1 on 88% / 5m for production pools. Also limit to dedicated pools (exclude dev/shared). Suggest adding a runbook note: "If SM > 88% AND mem > 90% -> escalate to infra oncall, consider scaling pool or triggering fallback model variant."

deploy-bot: Deploy succeeded: runtime/gpu-metrics v2.3.1 by Kevin — 1803001500

Maya: OK please file the PR for the alert change and paste link here. Also who can add a 1h/5m quick-switch to the Grafana dashboard?

Sam: I'll open the alert PR (assign to @Oliver) and follow up with a Grafana patch for the dashboard shortcuts. PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra-alerts/pull/452

Maya: Perfect — assigning follow-ups: @Oliver to update alert config, @Sam to update Grafana panels. I'll review the PR and check again after EOD :calendar:
